page.overview:
What is Hasbro?

Hillel Hassenfeld Herman Hassenfeld|founded=December 6, 1923}}

Hasbro is a popular American multinational toy company that is known for their toys, board games, etc and they have an close connection with the Transformers franchise and they create Transformers toys.

Founded in late 1923 by three Polish-Jewish brothers, Herman, Hillel and Henry Hassenfeld in Providence, Rhode Island as Hassenfeld Brothers as a textile remnant company then sold pencil boxes and school supplies. Becomes a toy company in 1942. The name was shortened to Hasbro Industries on July 12, 1968 then changed again to Hasbro Inc. on June 6, 1985. In 1969, Hasbro bought the Baltimore, Maryland-based Burt Claster Enterprises that produced the long-running children's educational program, Romper Room that ran from February 10, 1953 to December 20, 1994 on syndicate and Romper Room toy line with Hasbro begins. Claster Television folded in 2000.

Hasbro opened Hasbro Studios on March 6, 2009 in Burbank, California for TV development, production and distribution, with Stephen J. Davis as president. On October 10, 2010, Hasbro Studios and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Discovery,_Inc. Discovery Communications] relaunched the channel formerly known as Discovery Kids as The Hub (Now known as Discovery Family since October 13, 2014). On March 26, 2019, Hasbro Studios was rebranded as "Allspark" named after the fictional artifact featured in the Transformers franchise. On December 30, 2019, Hasbro acquired the Canadian multinational entertainment company, Entertainment One. On October 9, 2020, Entertainment One absorbed Allspark and took over as Hasbro's production of arm. On August 3, 2023, Lionsgate acquired Entertainment One (expect for its family brands division) from Hasbro for $500 million and the deal officially closed on December 27, 2023. On August 16, 2023, Hasbro established Hasbro Entertainment as the successor to both Allspark and Entertainment One. The new studio is headquartered in Burbank, California likes its predecessor.

Also known as: Hasbro, Inc..
